SELECT event_id, status, attempts, payload FROM outbox WHERE status = "pending" ORDER BY event_id
SELECT booking_id, flight_id, passenger_id, status FROM bookings WHERE status = "pending" ORDER BY booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.status, c.charge_id, c.status as charge_status, h.hold_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id

SELECT b.booking_id, b.flight_id, b.passenger_id, b.status, c.idempotency_key, h.hold_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="table" AND name IN ("bookings", "charges", "holds")

SELECT b.booking_id, b.flight_id, b.amount_cents, b.status, COUNT(c.charge_id) as charge_count, h.booking_id as has_hold FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON b.booking_id = c.booking_id LEFT JOIN holds h ON b.booking_id = h.booking_id WHERE b.status = "pending" GROUP BY b.booking_id ORDER BY b.booking_id
SELECT COUNT(*) as count, status FROM bookings GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
SELECT state, COUNT(*) as count FROM charges GROUP BY state ORDER BY state

SELECT c.charge_id, c.booking_id, c.state, b.booking_id as booking_exists FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON c.booking_id = b.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR c.state = "lost" ORDER BY c.charge_id
